description: quasiAthlete v1 F1 Load Ledger & Traffic-Light Rules. Edit any threshold below and refresh the app to test immediately.

highRiskCombos.label: Swimming + Upper-Body / Paddle Shoulder Stack
highRiskCombos.message: Simultaneous jump in swim volume and upper-body/paddle loading increases repetitive shoulder stress.

highRiskCombos.label: Erg Rowing + Track / Heavy Lower Lumbar Stack
highRiskCombos.message: Long/high erg volume stacked with track or heavy lower-body gym compounds lumbar and posterior-chain load.

highRiskCombos.label: Squash Court Density + Track / Lower Gym Stack
highRiskCombos.message: High-density squash change-of-direction work stacked with track impact or lower-body gym overloads lower-limb tissues.

swim.action: Trim swim volume by 20-30%, remove paddles and sprint sets, and keep pool sessions to easy technique.

erg.action: Trim erg minutes by 20-30%, cap continuous bouts at <=25 min with 2-3 min standing breaks, and cut hard intervals.

squash.action: Trim court minutes by 20-30% and replace group/conditioning sessions with low-density solo drills or rest.

track.action: Drop hills, plyometrics, and speed/interval sessions; convert track days to short easy runs or full rest.

gym_lower.action: Drop heavy lower-body sets (sprint_force: mobility or upper-only; distance_prehab: hold volume, zero novel eccentrics).

gym_upper.action: Drop heavy upper-body push/pull sets and paddle resistance; focus on pain-free scapular control or rest.
